Remark
[frame identity for a symmetric derivative]

Source: petersen:page-0373 ↗ prop:pet-ch9-vector-field-1form-duality 1. ch9:9.6.2For an arbitrary orthonormal frame $E_i$, derive \[ \sum _i g( abla _{E_i}X, abla _XE_i)=0 \] directly from symmetry of $v\mapsto abla _vX$; no parallelism of $E_i$ along $X$ may be assumed.
